question: Can the frozen CARRY-PNL-0031 sleeve improve the strict-router BRRK portfolio by using only capital that BRRK leaves idle, without reducing BRRK exposure or increasing combined gross above 1?

baseline.brkk_gross_source: frozen BRRK0011_BASELINE target weights from PIT-DISP-0015; held gross on day t uses target weights decided on t-1

carry.standalone_parity_requirement: reconstruction in this experiment must reproduce the persisted 0031 final value within $0.01 per $10,000 before any stack result is accepted

capital_rule.combined_gross_target: held_brrk_gross_t + carry_scale_t <= 1, apart from floating point tolerance
capital_rule.directional_authority: carry remains delta-neutral; it may not increase or decrease BRRK directional target
capital_rule.economic_interpretation: conservative fully-funded sub-account model: unit carry consumes unit capital for gross=1; no collateral sharing or leverage credit is assumed

daily_accounting.scale_change_cost: abs(carry_scale_t - carry_scale_{t-1}) * 5bps, with prior scale=0 on first stack day
daily_accounting.note: 0031 internal drift/rebalance transaction costs are already inside its net_5bps return and scale linearly with allocated capital; scale-change turnover is charged separately

required_outputs: common-window strict BRRK vs combined CAGR/MDD/vol/Sharpe/Calmar/final value
average/min/max carry scale and fraction of days carry is active
average combined gross and verification max <=1
incremental cumulative PNL from scaled carry before and after scale-change cost
worst drawdown dates and whether carry helped or hurt

qualification_rule.drawdown_nonworsening: combined max drawdown >= strict-router BRRK max drawdown
qualification_rule.decision: all five required for idle-capital stack qualification

prohibited: no fixed 80/20 or optimized stack weight
no reduction of BRRK exposure to make room for carry
no funding threshold or asset removal
no parameter search on carry scale
no use of future BRRK gross information
no same-window rescue tuning if the stack fails
implementation_limit: This is a capital-accounting stack test using Binance-qualified carry mechanics and the strict-router BRRK research path. It is not yet Hyperliquid execution evidence; venue-specific spot/collateral/netting/fees still require a later implementation study.
